ClassConfig.title: ClassConfig
ClassConfig.description: Saved class setup header defaults (course name, department, batch) for a user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID owning this configuration.

courseName.description: Course or class name shown in header and teacher output.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: Internal student record with contact details and current roll-call attendance toggle.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID owning this student roster entry.

name.description: Full name of the student (internal record only).

present.description: Whether the student is currently marked present in roll call.

comment.description: Optional internal note or comment about the student (max 500 chars).

photoData.description: Optional compressed JPEG thumbnail encoded as Base64 (max 100000 chars).

AttendanceSession.title: AttendanceSession
AttendanceSession.description: Saved class attendance snapshot containing class metadata, sorted present rolls, and formatted teacher output.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID owning this attendance session.

dateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of the class date for chronological sorting.

presentRolls.description: Sorted ascending list of present roll numbers.

totalStudents.description: Total student count in roster when saved.

/users/{userId}/class_configs/{configId}.description: Per-user saved class header configurations (course, department, batch).

/users/{userId}/students/{studentId}.description: Per-user internal student roster database and attendance status.

/users/{userId}/attendance_sessions/{ses.description: Per-user saved class attendance history records.
